commitResults.messageTitle: Make possible-typo warnings and duplicate errors easier to act on
commitResults.messageBody:
* Highlight the result display when the feedback contains a warning,
  so a possible-typo warning is not missed among the success message.
* Treat the same phone number written with and without a country code
  (+6591234567 and 91234567) as shared in possible-typo warnings.
* Name the existing engagement when an add or edit is rejected as a
  duplicate, so the user knows which engagement to edit instead.
* Store typographic apostrophes in names as straight apostrophes, so
  O’Connor and O'Connor are the same client.
* List the parameters a command accepts when it rejects an unsupported
  parameter.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Normalize apostrophes only in typed names, not when loading data
commitResults.messageBody:
A hand-edited data file that spells one engagement with both a curly
and a straight apostrophe would become a file with duplicates after
loading, so the whole file would fail to load and the app would start
empty. Loading now keeps the apostrophes as stored.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Match curly and straight apostrophes in name searches
commitResults.messageBody:
Typed names are now stored with straight apostrophes, so a search typed
with a curly apostrophe by autocorrect would no longer find them. Name
searches now normalize both the search text and the stored name.
Also tidy the related UG and DG wording.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Show command errors in red in the feedback panel
commitResults.messageBody:
Errors were shown in the same green as successful results, so a
rejected command such as a duplicate could be mistaken for a success
at a glance. Errors now use red, matching the command field's error
border; results stay green and warnings amber.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Accept only 1- to 3-digit country codes in possible-typo warnings
commitResults.messageBody:
+659123456789 and 23456789 were reported as the same phone apart from
a country code, although no country code has more than 3 digits.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commitResults.messageTitle: Show complete engagement fields in tooltips
commitResults.messageBody:
Engagement fields can be clipped in the list, requiring users to open
the details dialog to inspect individual values.

Add wrapped tooltips for the six displayed fields and document hovering
as an additional way to read complete values. Verify tooltip contents
for different cards using a focused, opt-in JavaFX test.

commitResults.messageTitle: Recover saved window positions outside connected screens
commitResults.messageBody:
Restoring coordinates from a disconnected monitor can leave ShutterLink
off-screen and prevent users from reaching its controls.

Restore saved coordinates only when a usable part of the title bar fits
within a connected screen's work area. Otherwise center the window while
preserving the saved size. Cover negative-coordinate monitors, taskbar
boundaries and disconnected screens with focused geometry tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add a shortcut to focus command input
commitResults.messageBody:
Keyboard users must tab through controls to resume entering commands
after navigating engagement records or reading feedback.

Focus the command input on Ctrl+L or Command+L without executing or
clearing unfinished text. Verify ordinary key handling, preserved
selection and unchanged engagement data using actual JavaFX controls.

commitResults.messageTitle: Find engagements by their complete stage name
commitResults.messageBody:
Photographers can view and edit stages but cannot use the existing find
command to review all engagements at a particular workflow stage.

Accept s/STAGE as the single search field, reuse stage validation, and
match the complete stage name ignoring case. Keep substring matching
for the other fields. Update command help and guides, and test all
stages, invalid inputs, previous-view replacement and list restoration.

commitResults.messageTitle: Address stage-search review and integrate latest master
commitResults.messageBody:
The guide initially implies that stage searches accept partial values,
and empty stage searches report a different error from other fields.

Limit the partial-matching explanation to the four text fields. Normalize
phone separators and reject empty values before field-specific parsing.
Cover empty and whitespace-only values across all five search fields.

Merge the team's error-message updates and reconcile supported-prefix
test expectations with the newly supported stage field.

commitResults.messageTitle: Keep oversized window title bars reachable on recovery
commitResults.messageBody:
Centering a saved window larger than the remaining screen can place its
title bar above the screen, leaving the recovery ineffective.

Compute centered fallback coordinates explicitly and clamp them to keep
the title-bar area inside the primary screen. Preserve saved dimensions
and coordinates. Share the visible-title dimensions with the position
check and cover the reported oversized-window case in regression tests.

commitResults.messageTitle: Exercise window recovery in graphical CI tests
commitResults.messageBody:
The geometry tests cover fallback calculations, but the MainWindow
integration is not executed by the default headless CI run.

Open actual stages with oversized and valid saved settings in a focused
JavaFX test. Run graphical tests under Xvfb on Linux CI so window recovery
is exercised and included in the uploaded coverage report.
